answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can trade, with the stake locked for a long vesting period like a terrace that only releases after sustained honest work. A new identity begins with no reputation, so a Sybil attacker must fund a separate stake and a separate voyage of verifiable service history for every fake identity, while the garden of shared attestations lets honest peers prune accounts whose work never checks out. Creating a thousand sock puppets then costs a thousand stakes and a thousand histories, which makes the attack unprofitable.
